text:
📢 FAU Cyber Club — Weekly Update

Today (Tuesday)
Marcos is leading a session on digital forensics using CyberDefenders. Come ready to learn!

This Week: Get VMware Running 💻
We want everyone to have VMware set up on their laptop by end of week. Here's a full walkthrough in our Google Drive:
🔗 https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/14eUxIDHD3H20GsTWKQIqdx6new3lXv1vUyHbuZfpWfY/edit

Thursday
Lab Stuff!

Linux and CTF practice in preparation for Saturday's competition. Don't miss it.

---

🏟️ SFISSA Village — This Weekend
We have a village at SFISSA on Friday and Saturday. Great chance to rep the club and network with people from Microsoft, IBM, and more. If you can make it either day, DM me so we can coordinate.

Code for anyone who didn't register yet: FAUHTF26

5000 T Rex Ave, Boca Raton, FL should get you there. It is running from 8 AM - 5 PM (Friday/Saturday)
---

🔑 Lab Swipe Access
Some members have already been approved for swipe access to the lab. If you want in, send me your Z number and I'll get you submitted for approval.

---

🤝 ShellHacks — FIU Hackathon
ShellHacks reached out to bring FAU Cyber Club on as a community partner. It's free, open to all skill levels, and has a sponsor fair with Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Base44. They're also working on a bus from FAU. I'm still ironing out the details with their team but sign up now — it's a great opportunity regardless.

---

🌟 SHPE National Convention (Shoutout)
Some club members are heading to the SHPE 2026 National Convention. Early-bird deadlines are coming up fast. SHPE brings in 200+ companies including Fortune 500s, so the networking alone is worth it. If you're interested, travel may be covered — DM me if you plan to apply so I can get a headcount.

Join the convention groupchat: https://chat.whatsapp.com/I0WWq5bUDVLBKKSa4kDw8J
Interest form: https://forms.gle/c7uXVWeb5Dnn54gDA

---

📅 Coming Soon
Better competition schedule, more guest speakers, a data center tour, and a lot more fun stuff on the way — stay tuned.

text:
some more info on ShellHacks for anyone interested 👀:

ShellHacks is a hackathon hosted at FIU this September! Their organizing team reached out to invite FAU Cybersecurity Club to become a community partner and bring our members out to represent FAU.

• Free to attend and open to all majors and skill levels—no hackathon experience needed!
• Workshops to learn new technical skills and a chance to build projects for your resume.
• A sponsor fair with recruiters from companies like Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Base44.
• They’re looking into providing a bus from FAU, so transportation may be covered! We’ll share updates once confirmed.
